'''Sir Martin Wyatt Holdgate''' {{post-nominals|country=GBR|CB}} (born 14 January 1931) is an English [[biologist]] and environmental scientist.

==Early life==
Holdgate was born in Horsham, England on 14 January 1931, grew up in [[Blackpool]],<ref name="FLD">{{cite web|url=http://www.fld.org.uk/sir-martin-holdgate-new-president-of-friends-of-the-lake-district.html|title=Sir Martin Holdgate – New President of Friends of the Lake District|date=22 July 2014|publisher=Friends of the Lake District|accessdate=23 July 2014}}</ref> and was educated at [[Arnold School]]. He then attended [[Cambridge University]] as an undergraduate at [[Queens' College, Cambridge]] from 1949, graduating in 1952 with degrees in [[zoology]] and [[botany]]<ref>[http://www.quns.cam.ac.uk/queens/misc/Eminent.html Eminent Alumni] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090616042915/http://www.quns.cam.ac.uk/Queens/Misc/Eminent.html |date=16 June 2009 }}, Queens's College, Cambridge, accessed 16 February 2010</ref> and, subsequently, a doctorate in insect physiology.<ref name="FLD" />

== Career ==

He taught at [[Manchester University]], [[Durham University]] and Cambridge, as well as undertaking expeditions to [[Tristan da Cunha]], south-west [[Chile]] and the [[Antarctic]].<ref name="FLD" /> He was Chief Biologist to the [[British Antarctic Survey]], then research director of the [[Nature Conservancy Council]] and, for eighteen years, Chief Scientist and head of research at the [[Department of the Environment]].<ref name="FLD" /> Subsequently, he was Director General of the [[International Union for Conservation of Nature]].<ref name="FLD" />

After his formal retirement, he was a member of the [[Royal Commission on Environmental Pollution]] and served as co-chair of the Intergovernmental Panel on Forests, and Secretary of the [[UN Secretary General]]'s High-Level Board on Sustainable Development.<ref name="FLD" />

==Awards and honours==

Holdgate has received numerous awards and honours for his work.<ref name="Debretts">[http://www.debretts.com/people/biographies/browse/h/447/Martin%20Wyatt+HOLDGATE.aspx Sir Martin Holdgate, CB] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130720074908/http://www.debretts.com/people/biographies/browse/h/447/Martin%20Wyatt+HOLDGATE.aspx |date=20 July 2013 }}, Debretts 'People of Today', accessed 16 February 2010</ref>

* {{Timeline-event |date={{Start date|1964}} |event= [[W. S. Bruce Medal]] of the [[Royal Society of Edinburgh]]}}
* {{Timeline-event |date={{Start date|1979}} |event= [[Companion of the Order of the Bath]] (CB)}}
* {{Timeline-event |date={{Start date|1983}} |event= [[UNEP Silver Medal]] from the [[United Nations Environment Programme]]}}
* {{Timeline-event |date={{Start date|1988}} |event= [[UNEP 500 Award]] also from the United Nations Environment Programme}}
* {{Timeline-event |date={{Start date|1991}} |event= Commander [[Order of the Golden Ark]] (Netherlands)}}
* {{Timeline-event |date={{Start date|1991}} |event= [[Honorary degree|Honorary]] [[DSc]] from the [[University of Durham]]}}
* {{Timeline-event |date={{Start date|1992}} |event= [[Patron's Medal]] of the [[Royal Geographical Society]]}}
* {{Timeline-event |date={{Start date|1993}} |event= [[Livingstone Medal]] of the [[Royal Scottish Geographical Society]]}}
* {{Timeline-event |date={{Start date|1993}} |event= Honorary DSc from the [[University of Sussex]]}}
* {{Timeline-event |date={{Start date|1994}} |event= [[Knight Bachelor]] (styled ''Sir Martin Holdgate, CB'')}}
* {{Timeline-event |date={{Start date|1995}} |event= Honorary DSc from the [[University of Lancaster]]}}
* {{Timeline-event |date={{Start date|1997}} |event= [[Honorary Fellow]] of [[Royal Holloway, University of London]]}}
* {{Timeline-event |date={{Start date|2000}} |event= Honorary member of the [[International Union for Conservation of Nature]] (IUCN)}}
* {{Timeline-event |date={{Start date|2005}} |event= Honorary Fellow of the [[Zoological Society of London]]}}
* {{Timeline-event |date={{Start date|2006}} |event= Honorary DSc from [[Queen Mary, University of London]]}}

Holdgate has been President of the [[Zoological Society of London]] and of the [[Freshwater Biological Association]].<ref name="FLD" /> He is also a member and fellow of the [[Institute of Biology]], making him a [[Chartered Biologist]], and entitling him to use the designations '''C.Biol''' and '''F.I.Biol'''. In July 2014, he was appointed President of Friends of the Lake District.<ref name="FLD" />

==Publications==

Holdgate edited the journal ''Antarctic Ecology'' (published for the [[Scientific Committee on Antarctic Research]], by the [[Academic Press]]) from the first edition in 1970. His publications include the following:<ref name="Debretts"/>

* {{cite book| first=Martin |last=Holdgate| author-mask=2| title=Mountains in the Sea |publisher=Macmillan; St.Martin's Press |year=1958 }}
* {{cite book| first=Martin |last=Holdgate| author-mask=2| title=A Perspective of Environmental Pollution |publisher=Cambridge University Press |year=1979|isbn=978-0521221979 }}
* {{cite book | first=Martin | last=Holdgate | author-mask=2 | title=From Care to Action | publisher=Hemisphere | year=1996 | isbn=978-1560325604 | url-access=registration | url=https://archive.org/details/fromcaretoaction0000hold }}
* {{cite book| first=Martin |last=Holdgate| author-mask=2| title=The Green Web: A Union for World Conservation |publisher=Routledge |year=1999|isbn=978-1853835957 }}
* {{cite book| first=Martin |last=Holdgate| author-mask=2| title=Penguins and Mandarins: Memories of Natural and Un-Natural History |publisher=Memoir Club |year=2003|isbn=978-1841040790 }}
* {{cite book| first=Martin |last=Holdgate| author-mask=2| title=The Story of Appleby in Westmorland |publisher= Hayloft Publishing |year=2006|isbn=978-1904524359 }}
* {{cite book| first=Martin |last=Holdgate| author-mask=2| title=Arnold: the story of a Blackpool school |publisher=Hayloft Publishing |year=2009|isbn=978-1904524632 }}

=== As editor ===
* {{cite book| title=The World Environment 1972–82 |publisher=Tycooly International Publishing Ltd |year=1982|isbn=978-0907567141 }} (joint editor)
